scope: Proposition 5.1 (Support obstruction) of the manuscript “Random-subspace tests and trace smoothing for coordinate sweeps” (preprints/Random-subspace-tests-and-trace-smoothing-for-coordinate-sweeps-September-26-2026/paper.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 238 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 9e1c693d0e6175b9), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 13. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: After t physical shuffles the total-variation dis- tance from uniform is at least 1 − 2tn/2/n!. Thus mixing to distance 1/4 requires at least ⌈(2/n) log2(3n!/4)⌉ = 2d − O(1) physical shuffles.
